youtube_title: Lightning in an Open Ground: Hide Under a Tree or Run Inside? Brave vs Normal #9 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BRAVE vs NORMAL - WHO'S RIGHT? #9. You're on an open ground and lightning starts. Brave wants to shelter under the big lone tree. Normal runs away from the tree into a pucca building. Who's right?
Answer: Normal. IMD and NDMA lightning advice: never take shelter under an isolated tree - lightning tends to strike the tallest thing around. A pucca building or a closed hard-top car is safest. Caught in the open with no shelter? Squat low with feet together and head down, and don't lie flat on the ground.
Source: IMD Thunderstorm and Lightning Do's and Don'ts; NDMA lightning awareness.
